Dear Team,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to kindly follow up on my previous message regarding the
payment of my October affiliate commissions through the GoAffPro platform.

I reached out a few days ago but haven't received a response yet. I would
really appreciate it if you could provide an update on the payment status
and let me know when I can expect the October commissions to be processed.

Thank you very much for your time and assistance. I look forward to hearing
from you soon.

Best regards,

Huong
